pricing_notes: All 7-night totals below were read directly from live Booking.com room-rate tables for 2 adults, 1 room, in USD on 2026-11-26 (plus two luxury Shanghai benchmarks verified 2026-11-25 in repo data/hotels.json and cross-checked). Rates are dynamic and exclude China VAT (6% or 6.6% as explicitly stated per listing); service charge inclusion is shown per property. Every ranked property passes both mandatory requirements: private/attached bathroom AND queen or king bed.

booking_timing_finding.headline: Book Refundable Rates During the Active Black Friday Window (Nov 19 – Dec 2, 2026) for 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-22
evidence: base-Beijing Wangfujing Serviced Apartment drops 51% from $866 to $425/7N on 2027-02-15 -> 2027-02-22 via an active Black Friday Deal (stays Nov 19, 2026 – Dec 31, 2027) + weekly rate + Booking.com Pays, with FREE cancellation until 2027-02-14.
Park Plaza Beijing Wangfujing is $749/7N (Genius) on Feb 15-22 and Mar 1-8, jumping +23.4% to $924/7N by Mar 16-23.
Radisson Blu Shanghai New World is $921/7N (Genius) on Feb 15-22, jumping +56.1% to $1,438/7N by Mar 16-23.
Pullman Shanghai Jing'an (Superior King) is $621 non-ref / $707 free-cancel on Feb 15-22, jumping +36.1% to $845 non-ref / $963 free-cancel by Mar 16-23.

booking_timing_finding.action: Locking a free-cancellation, pay-at-property or pay-later rate for 2027-02-15 -> 2027-02-22 immediately captures post-Spring Festival trough pricing with zero downside if dates shift.

proximity_methodology: We do NOT fabricate exact minute-by-minute subway counts for restaurants whose transit schedules were not queried via a live routing engine. Instead, we report: (1) verified hotel-to-subway walk distances stated on the property listing, (2) verified district/corridor counts of MICHELIN-starred restaurants (Beijing 33/33 audited: 20 Chaoyang, 9 Dongcheng, 3 Xicheng, 1 Shunyi; Shanghai live guide: 50 starred heavily concentrated in Huangpu, Jing'an, Xuhui & Changning), and (3) transparent '<=60 min transit reach' coverage ranges with explicit outliers flagged (e.g., Beijing 2* Blackswan in Shunyi Capital Airport corridor requires taxi/Airport Express + transfer; Xicheng/Chaoyang cross-city hops take 25-45 min on Lines 1/5/8/10/17).
